{"answer": "The checkout page already contains a working payment button. The existing flow is complete and functional:

- `web/index.html` includes a `<form id="checkout-form">` with a payment method `<select>` (card / bank_transfer) and a submit button `<button type="submit" id="pay-button">Pay now</button>`.
- `web/app.js` wires that button to the existing checkout flow: on submit it disables the button, shows "Processing payment...", POSTs the cart and selected method to `/api/checkout`, then renders either the payment status/amount or a failure message, and re-enables the button.
- The backend `Handler.do_POST` in the server routes `/api/checkout` to `create_checkout`, which validates the cart and method and returns `{status, amount_cents, method}`.

No code changes were required: the payment button is already present and correctly integrated with the existing checkout flow.
